title: Hoymiles releases a 2,000 kWh C&I energy storage solution
content:

title: Novel PV recycling method removes EVA at 9 grams per second
content:
Researchers in China have developed a preheating-assisted mechanical polishing process to remove ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) encapsulants from end-of-life solar modules. The technique reportedly achieves an EVA recovery rate of 99% and a removal rate of 9 g/s, while preserving the integrity of silicon wafers.

content:

title: U.S. distributed solar generation quadrupled over the last decade
content: Rooftop solar output expanded from 18.8 TWh to nearly 93 TWh over ten years, led by California, Arizona, Texas, Florida, and New York, according to EIA data.

title: Budderfly plans 150 MW municipal VPP with solar, storage in U.S. cities
content: Budderfly says it plans to aggregate municipal energy systems into a 150 MW virtual power plant (VPP) under a $500 million program to finance solar, battery storage and efficiency upgrades for US cities. Its first disclosed municipal contract, in Cadillac, Michigan, runs for 15 years.

title: The chemical compliance gap at battery storage sites: What solar O&M teams are still missing after the 2025 BESS fires
content: While physical safety measures and fire suppression dominate BESS risk discussions, the industry's weakest link remains chemical documentation compliance—where outdated or inaccessible safety data sheets can stall emergency response and trigger severe OSHA penalties.

title: Ontario grid operator proposes regulation market role for batteries
content: The grid operator in the Canadian province of Ontario has proposed a design to let transmission-connected batteries provide regulation service while also selling energy and operating reserve, under a phase planned for 2028.
